n10_subtask: N10.3 same-runtime caller-cancel stop repeatability sample 3 of 3
hypothesis: A third fresh independent cold start under the exact [0.60,0.66] m/s caller-cancel protocol will complete a third comparable measurement for a finite-sample summary; no general guarantee will be inferred from three samples.
single_primary_variable: No configuration or measurement variable changes; this is independent repeat 3 of 3. The independent unit is a fresh Gazebo/PX4/VINS cold start with unique epoch and goal identity.

basis.interpretation: Third independent sample under the exact same configuration. Two prior samples were close, but n=2 is descriptive only and does not set a stopping guarantee.

task.route: one +16.0 m ENU / +0.10 m / +0.20 rad EGO goal; caller cancel at the first matching PX4 horizontal-speed sample in the window; observe replacement EGO trajectory and PX4 stop band; bridge-owned landing
task.contacts: read-only observer; no collision geometry changes

localization_policy.retained: VINS epoch/frame/time and map identity; PX4 native preflight and EV fusion; upstream EGO collision/watchdog; unique PX4 bridge

measurement_definition.trigger: matching current-goal/current-epoch READY position command plus valid PX4 XY/Z local position, horizontal speed in [0.60,0.66] m/s and nonzero reference speed
measurement_definition.cancel: caller cancel accepted and action reports caller_cancel
measurement_definition.trajectory: observe a new EGO trajectory id after cancellation
measurement_definition.stop_band: PX4 horizontal speed <=0.03 m/s and absolute vertical speed <=0.05 m/s continuously for >=1.0 simulated second
additional_measurements: truth cancel-to-stop path length and endpoint displacement
PX4 deceleration and time to 10% speed reduction
contact observer coverage and prohibited contacts

acceptance_criteria.measurement_complete: trigger speed observed in the frozen window; caller cancel acknowledged; different replacement trajectory id observed; stop band fully covered; truth interval bounded; contact observer complete with zero prohibited contacts; independent terminal readback safe
acceptance_criteria.scope: validity of this diagnostic sample only; no guarantee or final stopping-distance acceptance threshold

run_commands.safe_stop: bash tools/project.sh stop n10-20261027-379-speed060-repeat02 only after safe-to-stop.json is true

limitations: Single fresh SITL run; cannot establish a general braking guarantee.
No project-local health thresholds are reintroduced.
PX4 native preflight, bridge state machine, and official EGO collision behavior remain in force.
